title_sq: Shitet 2+1 + Parkim te Stadiumi Air Albania!
description_sq:
Zona e Stadiumit "Air Albania" eshte nje nga zonat me elitare te Tiranes, e preferuar per banim apo per zhvillimin e bizneseve.
Ne rrugen "Faik Konica", ne nje ndertim qe perfundon vitin e ardhshem, ofrojme per shitje apartament me siperfaqe 143m².
Organizohet si apartament me dy dhoma gjumi, ambient ndenje, kuzhine e vecuar, dy tualete dhe ballkon.
Ky apartament i permbush gjithe kerkesat qe nje banor i kesaj zone kerkon: ndertimi cilesor, pamja e lire, drite dielli, parkim i siguruar dhe komunitet elitar.
Nese jane keto kushtet qe ti kerkon, te ftoj te me kontaktosh per te lene nje takim nga afer!
title_en: For sale 2+1 + Parking at Air Albania Stadium!
description_en: The area of ​​the "Air Albania" Stadium is one of the most elite areas of Tirana, preferred for housing or business development. On "Faik Konica" street, in a building that will end next year, we offer for sale an apartment with an area of ​​143m². It is organized as an apartment with two bedrooms, living room, separate kitchen, two toilets and a balcony. This apartment fulfills all the requirements that a resident of this area looks for: quality construction, free view, sunlight, secured parking and elite community. If these are the conditions you are looking for, I invite you to contact me to make a meeting nearby!
